name: Infectious Disease Treatment Centre
description: A user friendly IDTM guide for the Infectious Disease Treatment Centre facility, providing step-by-step installation, maintenance, and dismantling instructions.
manufacturer: LANCO - Dr. Lange GmbH & Co. KG

components.name: Vestibule External Cover (Left)
components.description: External cover for left entrance vestibule

components.name: Vestibule External Cover (Right)
components.description: External cover for right entrance vestibule

steps.title: Packing List Verification
steps.description: Verify all components are present before starting installation. Check each item against the packing list and inspect for any damage during transport.
warnings: Do not proceed with installation if any components are missing or damaged
Report any discrepancies immediately to the supplier

steps.title: Install Lightweight Flooring
steps.description: Lay out the modular flooring panels in the designated area. Ensure the ground is level and free from sharp objects. Connect panels together following the numbered sequence.
warnings: Ensure ground is level before laying flooring
Check for sharp objects that could puncture the flooring

steps.title: Install Main Tent Pneumatic Structure
steps.description: Position the pneumatic arches on the flooring. Connect the inflation pump and inflate to the recommended pressure (check pressure gauge). Ensure all arches are properly inflated and secure.
warnings: Do not over-inflate - check pressure gauge regularly
Ensure all valves are properly closed after inflation
Keep inflation pump accessible for pressure adjustments

steps.title: Install Main Tent External Cover
steps.description: Carefully drape the external cover over the inflated structure. Secure all connection points, guy ropes, and mud flaps. Ensure proper tensioning to prevent water pooling.
warnings: Ensure cover is properly aligned before securing
Check that mechanical openings are correctly positioned
Verify all guy ropes are properly tensioned

steps.title: Install Insulation Liner
steps.description: Attach the internal insulation liner to the main structure. Ensure all mechanical openings align correctly. Secure all fasteners and check for gaps.
warnings: Ensure mechanical openings are aligned correctly
Check for gaps that could reduce insulation effectiveness

steps.title: Install Vestibule Structures
steps.description: Install both left and right vestibule structures. Inflate pneumatic frames, attach external covers, and connect to main tent using zipper connections.
warnings: Ensure zipper connections are fully closed
Check rain-dust protection flaps are properly positioned
Verify vestibule pressure matches main tent

steps.title: Install Sun Shadowing Net
steps.description: Position distance tubes and drape sun shadowing net over the main tent roof. This provides UV protection and reduces internal temperature.
warnings: Ensure net does not touch the tent surface directly
Secure all corners to prevent wind displacement

steps.title: Final Installation Inspection
steps.description: Conduct a complete walk-through inspection. Check all connections, inflation pressure, guy ropes, and mechanical openings. Test all entry/exit points.
warnings: Do not mark installation complete if any issues are found
Document any deviations from standard setup

steps.title: Daily Maintenance Checks
steps.description: Perform daily visual inspection of structure, check inflation pressure, inspect for tears or damage, verify all connections are secure.
warnings: Report any pressure loss immediately
Document all findings in maintenance log

steps.title: Weekly Maintenance Checks
steps.description: Thorough inspection of all fabric surfaces, guy ropes, mechanical openings. Check flooring integrity. Clean and inspect all components.
warnings: Address any wear or damage promptly
Keep detailed maintenance records

steps.title: Prepare for Dismantling
steps.description: Clear all equipment and supplies from the facility. Ensure all components are clean and dry. Take inventory of all items.
warnings: Do not dismantle in wet conditions if possible
Ensure all components are clean before packing

steps.title: Reverse Installation Process
steps.description: Remove components in reverse order of installation. Start with sun net, then vestibules, insulation, external cover, pneumatic structure, and finally flooring.
warnings: Deflate structures slowly to prevent damage
Fold components according to manufacturer instructions
Label all components for easy reassembly

steps.title: Pack and Document
steps.description: Pack all components in their designated containers. Complete packing list verification. Document condition of all items and note any repairs needed.
warnings: Ensure all components are completely dry before packing
Document any damage for repair or replacement
